request.title: Artwork pipeline test — the lantern and the die
request.prompt: Create an original cinematic fantasy illustration, wide landscape composition, of a small brass lantern and a single large faceted twenty-sided die on a worn wooden tavern table, beside a closed leather adventurer's journal. Warm amber lamplight, a softly blurred empty medieval tavern in the background, painterly detail, a quiet sense of adventure. The die's visible faces have simple engraved geometric markings rather than readable numbers. No people, no writing, no logos, no watermark. This is a fictional pipeline test, not a scene from the War of the Gods campaign.
request.alt: A brass lantern illuminates a faceted die and closed leather journal on an empty tavern table.
